evidence.claim: Agreed to buy Trench Group (bushings, instrument transformers, coils) for $9.0bn, 13x 2028E EBITDA, to vertically integrate a supplier and add high-voltage capacity; Electrification equipment backlog $42.2bn, +60% YoY.
evidence.numbers: Paying 18x 2026E EBITDA for a component maker signals grid equipment, not just turbines, is a binding constraint; close only in late 2027.
evidence.source: GE Vernova 3Q26 release and webcast slides

evidence.claim: Gas turbine shipments reached 5.3 GW in 3Q26 (3.3 GW in 2Q), the planned 5 GW a quarter run rate, while gas equipment backlog grew from 53 to 64 GW.
evidence.numbers: Even at 20 GW a year of output, backlog of 64 GW plus 58 GW of SRAs is about six years of production, so new gas capacity ordered today arrives around 2030 or later.

evidence.claim: Josh preview: Galaxy's 830 MW of approved grid power at Helios is still unleased because it energizes only in late 2028 and Texas has gated large loads.
evidence.numbers: Tenants are not paying for grid power that arrives after 2027.

evidence.claim: Tone softened in 3Q26: current capacity plus what is scheduled to come online 'gives us the flexibility' to allocate across training, core and new products. Commitments still rose 30% QoQ.

Microsoft exited Nscale's 90 MW Loughton, UK site because UK Power Networks cannot connect it until the early-to-mid 2030s; Ofgem counts about 73 GW of data center projects queued against about 45 GW of UK peak demand.
evidence.numbers: A signed hyperscaler lease was lost purely to grid timing.

evidence.claim: Trucking natural gas to keep sites running in Utah and Texas while pipelines lag.
Force majeure notice on its 2.45 GW Project Jupiter site in New Mexico over gas pipeline and air-permit delays.
Shayle Kann expects the US to add more grid capacity in about two years than in any year in decades.
Meta says it is planning 2028 for flexibility: securing land and power now and deciding on chips later. It also said capacity is the constraint and near-term capacity is worth more than long-term.
evidence.numbers: 2026 capex guide then $130-145bn; leases not commenced $278.99bn at 30 Jun 2026.

evidence.claim: SemiAnalysis reports utility promises such as 1 GW by 2027 turning into 100 MW by 2029, with no penalty for missing.
CEO says Power & Energy output is paced by capacity with 'no slack in the system'; 4Q guided only to moderate growth; 58% of backlog ships within 12 months (59% in 2Q).
evidence.numbers: Book-to-bill about 1.3x (derived: MP&E sales $19.65bn plus $5.9bn backlog growth). Lead times lengthened from late 2028 (August) to 2029 for large gas engines.

question: Will chips arrive at sites that have no power in 2027?
summary: Utility dates are slipping and the gap is now costing signed deals: Microsoft dropped Nscale's UK flagship over a 2030s grid date, and Galaxy's 830 MW cannot be leased until it energizes in late 2028. Oracle's trucked gas shows the same gap in the US. The counterview is that US grid additions surge from about 2028.
title: Power arriving after the chips
